answer: Sponsor-bond admission with decaying reputation blocks fakes. A newcomer needs a sponsor staking a 200-credit bond; that standing, a beacon, decays 5% per epoch unless the newcomer behaves honestly. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 bonds, 200,000 credits locked; rented reputation slashes sponsor and newcomer, leaving a sable mark on its record. A fake flares like a comet and dies in 20 epochs, while one honest bond keeps rewards undiluted.
